title: Kinetic and Thermodynamic Control of Macrocyclic Peptide Conformation through Late-Stage Chemical Modification.
authors: Ou, Yang Daniel; Hur, Joonseong; Baloh, Chloe; Huang, Benzhen; Kovljenic, Nenad; Dudding, Travis; Yudin, Andrei K
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过化学修饰控制大环肽构象，结合NMR和分子动力学模拟研究构象变化，涉及蛋白质结构计算（MD模拟），但核心是化学方法而非AI/深度学习，对象为肽类，问题为构象控制，方法有MD模拟，综合评7分。
abstract: We describe the use of lactone ring-opening as a chemical tool for producing differentiated conformations of macrocyclic peptides. Under kinetic control, the lactone opening is highly atroposelective across macrocyclic precursors tested. Under thermodynamic control, reversible lactone opening equilibrates the atropisomers. A combined NMR/molecular dynamics study reveals that the atropisomers arising from lactone opening can adopt markedly different conformations, ranging from a 310-helix to various noncanonical conformations. In the RGD-containing macrocycle, the kinetic atropisomer recapitulates the 3D geometry involved in integrin binding, whereas the thermodynamic atropisomer adopts a distinct conformation that was not previously described. Together, these results establish a new strategy to control the conformational states of macrocyclic peptides.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了利用内酯开环作为一种化学工具，用于产生大环肽的差异化构象。在动力学控制下，内酯开环在所测试的大环前体中表现出高度的对映选择性。在热力学控制下，可逆的内酯开环使阻转异构体达到平衡。结合核磁共振/分子动力学研究揭示，由内酯开环产生的阻转异构体可以呈现显著不同的构象，范围从310-螺旋到各种非经典构象。在含有RGD的大环中，动力学阻转异构体重现了参与整合素结合的三维几何结构，而热力学阻转异构体则采用了一种先前未被描述的不同构象。综合这些结果，确立了一种控制大环肽构象状态的新策略。
